test_title: PYST 32: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
A # B means ‘A is the brother of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son of B’

A & B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A % B means ‘A is the mother of B’

If A % B & C # D @ E, then how is B related to E?
solution:

Find how is B related to E.

Given:- A % B & C # D @ E

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b1d4aff766804a1995dd7e112b50832b88221fc53c40bed7a4b96a1048d4d6b.png] 

Clearly, B is the **"Daughter-in-law" **of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Daughter-in-law".**
